Name: Shiro from Suikoden II retexture for the horse
Author: linasouls9
Description:
I know this may not how you remember Shiro from Suikoden II, but I did try my very best to get it to look like him. It has taken me months to do this. I have been working on this while making other mods at the same time. I do hope you guys do like it. Again for those that don't know Suikoden this a mod that replaces your horse with a wolf. Try out this mod if you want, do hope you guys like it, if you don't then that is fine with me.

Make sure to place the file in Animals under Content.

I have edited the original sprites a lot due to fitting them in the sprite animations

Downloads.Description: Put file in Animals under Content
